assets.label: Generated Recon
assets.notes: Fitted 26-bone deform rig, 26 modular mesh nodes, 14523 triangles, shared 2K albedo atlas and protected face material; runtime poses, idles and equipment slots.

assets.label: Recon — original comparison
assets.notes: Untouched complete inbound model for the owner-requested as-is comparison view: 193534 triangles and original 4K texture. Inspection reference; excluded from the gameplay operator budget.

assets.label: Recon — source teardown
assets.notes: Byte-identical split source for numbered inspection: 27 pieces, 195765 triangles. Diagnostic reference only; excluded from the gameplay operator budget.

assets.label: Recon clothing foundation
assets.notes: CM3 modular foundation: 5,568 triangles including removable mask and cap, complete stylized head and 1,200-triangle articulated gloves. Recon v2 adds thirty finger joints while preserving all 26 v1 body frames. Rebuild with assets:recon-foundation.

assets.label: Recon lightweight plate carrier
assets.notes: CM5 independent 1,116-triangle pack: closed front/rear bags, shoulder straps/pads, buckles, fitted cummerbund and removable placard. Combined loaded foundation and carrier: 6,684 triangles. Rebuild with assets:recon-carrier.

assets.label: Recon modular pouch templates
assets.notes: CM6 mount-local magazine (264), utility (220) and radio/cable (376) templates. Repeated mounted copies are budgeted per instance; six radios plus loaded foundation/carrier total 8,940 triangles. Rebuild with assets:recon-pouches.
